quest.title: A Lady's Invitation
quest.description: You receive a tea party invitation letter from Sandrone...\nNote: <color=#FFE14BFF>It is recommended that you complete</color> "Sunny Summer Fontinalia" for the best experience.
quest.rewards_formatted: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table x1, Sandrone's Tea Party Invitation Letter x1

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Didn't your letter say we were having a tea party? How come there's nothing here? Don't tell Paimon this is a snack-free get-together!?

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Hah, I bet you would love that, Paimon? You really think I'd forget the food?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Did... Did that table just appear out of thin air!?

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Hehe, impressive, right? This is my newly developed portable tea table.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: It's easy to carry and store, and even equipped with a hover device, just like Fagio.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: What's even more impressive is... Oh, uhm, never mind, I don't want to show off and make this sound like a sales pitch. You can check it out for yourselves.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Here, I've prepared some tea and snacks.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll help myself then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm...! These are so delicious! You really are a great cook!

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Naturally.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But what inspired you to make something like this?

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: I wanted to be able to enjoy pleasant tea parties with friends wherever they are, of course.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: I've said this before. Holding on to what you already have isn't the only way to preserve what's precious.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Lately, I've found myself wanting to go on walks and visit my friends more often.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: But inviting myself to others' homes and expecting them to prepare tea and treats, then letting them clear the table afterward... It's hardly proper etiquette for a lady.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon doesn't think your friends would mind.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: I mind. Besides, a simple invention like this is no trouble at all for me.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: I can see you like it. Don't worry, I can make one for you, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? Are you sure that's alright?

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: It's perfectly fine. Like I told you, I can whip up something like this in no time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: In that case, thank you very much...

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Don't mention it. You helped me out a lot during the Fontinalia Festival. Consider this as thanks.

choices.text: Hope we didn't keep you waiting.

talks.objective: Go to the agreed-upon location to take part in Sandrone's tea party
Go to the agreed-upon location to take part in Sandrone's tea party

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? We've received an invitation? Judging by the envelope... Oh! It must be from Sandrone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we've been invited to a tea party. Hehe, Paimon can't wait! C'mon, let's go!
